newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso trading volume hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso trading volume hits record high.

text.p: Computerised Philippine peso/U.S. dollar trading volume hit an intraday record high of $492 million in volatile activity on Friday.
It exceeded the $446.3 million worth of trades on January 9 when the peso was hammered after interest rates fell sharply following a reserve requirement cut.

The peso has been hit by speculation as recent attacks on the Thai baht unnerved the Philippine currency market. The Central Bank was forced to raise its key overnight borrowing rate by seven percentage points to 20 percent on Friday, in another move aimed at calming the market.
Banks are now dumping their dollars after the Central Bank's action, which saw the peso firm to 26.368 after opening at 26.375 to the dollar.
